current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: He also checks solicitation and product risk and later accepts the bonus check. One failure is not global unreliability; correction does not prove remorse.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-03 whole supplied edition; exact routes in linked seven-question sidecar
current_accepted_append.observation: U013:P0218–0247: he understands the guards are caught and still being swallowed, stops Yunyun's available rescue for dispensable gratification, and only she completes it.
current_accepted_append.implication: Downgrade any unqualified protective override; retain a conditional capacity for protection.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: U014:P0194–0240: he follows the girls and actually stops the castle-gate chant, then offers a plan; leisure competition is not equivalently established there. The guards are current paid companions. Slow digestion does not remove the understood near-term coercive danger, and eventual rescue does not excuse his choice. His useful prior offer P0220 remains, but the later deliberate obstruction is decisive contrary behavior. U011:P0763–0768 also retains actual assault on Yunyun under a protective rationale, not pure care. No original forecast retirement or new numeric validation cohort; the broad tendency now requires a stronger boundary against pleasure-driven obstruction.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-03 whole supplied edition; exact routes in linked seven-question sidecar
current_accepted_append.observation: No adequately depicted case pairs a particular recognized Leen need with a usable Dust-owned resource of competing value and an actual gift/help transfer.
current_accepted_append.implication: No new confirmation from reversed or merely prospective care.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: Leen funds drink and teleport, notices his distress, helps the plan, and accepts delayed disclosure (U014:P0151–0207;U016:P0028–0044), but these are her actions toward him. Dust's promise to explain his past is future, not an already delivered resource. His continued harassment after intending restraint is adverse relationship evidence, but not automatically a full resource-gift trial. Do not count the inverse direction as Dust's generosity. Keep the question open without inventing a favorable test or overwriting Dust02's distinct local assessment.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-03 whole supplied edition; exact routes in linked seven-question sidecar

current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: U016:P0006–0007 explicitly recalls the lady's instruction: spear use for her or another truly protected person is permitted; otherwise use the sword. The flight requires dragon handling, etiquette and disguise, not an explicitly necessary superior spear solution. Nonuse alone cannot establish the full trigger. His tentative permission appraisal is real; the named former lady and full historical scene remain unknown locally. Resolve only the exact-wording portion of the open question; preserve the original UNKNOWN as its historical state and do not amend its future fields.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-03 whole supplied edition; exact routes in linked seven-question sidecar

current_accepted_append.implication: Retain bounded underchecking; reject an every-reward-fails account.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: U012:P0214–0223 and U013:P0695–0722: Dust asks about side effects/harm and declines ingestion. Bonus U020:P0025–0050: client inquiry plus Leen-prompted purpose check occur before capture; cancellation fee is received. Treasury provenance is available before ring commitment, but exact royal crest and shop refusal are later information; do not claim he knowingly ignored an already announced resale ban. The gift/loan disagreement U014:P0185–0186 is competing provider/accounting testimony, not proof of a stable term he intentionally ignored. Keep both supportive and adverse comparable checking behavior, with partial trigger comparability explicit and no accuracy denominator.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-03 whole supplied edition; exact routes in linked seven-question sidecar
current_accepted_append.observation: U011:P0338–0351/0519–0573: Lolisa investigates missing clients, providers ask to join for professional recovery, and the requested liquor advance carries a no-en-route-drinking condition.
current_accepted_append.implication: Preserve provider-controlled, purpose-bounded cooperation without claiming all costs were freely accepted.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: U011:P0656–0660: she volunteers the diversion and expressly confirms it when Dust asks. This is her own client-recovery aim, not merely praise-induced obedience. The later threat of unwanted dreams at P0736 is Dust's request-threat to clients; specific provider agreement to enact it is not shown, and no dream is performed. Her fan persona toward Vanir and manager-directed Wiz handling do not establish a freely owned veto in those separate acts. Bounded cooperation supports agency, while the praise-plus-owned-veto conjunction is incompletely instantiated. No blanket compliance claim or exculpation of Dust.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-03 whole supplied edition; exact routes in linked seven-question sidecar
current_accepted_append.observation: U011:P0623–0739: outnumbered at the plant, Dust accepts providers' volunteered diversion and helps split the coalition; he rejects or postpones a frontal fight.
current_accepted_append.implication: Keep the tactical rearrangement mechanism; do not infer safe or ethical total success.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: U014:P0240–0344: agreed helpers, rumors, a false Kazuma report, one-day borrowed helmet/armor and trained etiquette stall superior-position guards and enable entry. He also considers forcing Yunyun into battle (U011:P0654) before the accepted diversion. Some guards leave, some apologize; total customer recovery is not enumerated. Helpers have different knowledge; no modern ethical approval condition is added to the prediction. Actual threat, collateral risk and deception remain. Confirm this bounded tactical tendency qualitatively, not as an independent trial lineage or proof of overall benevolence.

current_accepted_append.native_routes: DUST-03 whole supplied edition; exact routes in linked seven-question sidecar
current_accepted_append.observation: U013:P0758–0807: an audible mind-swap description is followed by an invented unremembered provider visit and a confident dream explanation. U014:P0009–0022 directly corrects it and he updates.
current_accepted_append.implication: Retain appetite-aligned premature inference; reject global unreliability.
current_accepted_append.authority_and_adverse_limit: U011:P0248–0278 and P0523–0540 show suspicion, questions and refusal; U020:P0039–0050 shows a meaningful rival explanation adopted before action. Intoxication and memory gaps are real state modifiers, not proof that the swap clue was absent. Iris's later gratitude check U017:P0032–0039 reveals an unanticipated concealment weakness. The helmeted noble's inner motive is not separately proved from Dust's innocent explanation alone. Local confirmation includes correction and counterexamples; no frozen main inference score or later holdout is recoded.
